review.notes: Full read-through of the 387-line OCR markdown against extracted text of all 17 physical pages; physical pages 5, 6, 7, 12, 14 and 15 rendered and visually inspected (footnote strips, Baselines wording, references). No code fences in the source. All 11 page-bottom footnote bodies (2-12) were dropped by OCR and are reinserted here; three Riffusion/Diffusion misreads repaired. Citation punctuation after inline math is handled by the shared normalizer. Table cell values on pages 6-11, 14-15 spot-checked against renders without finding defects; dense table arithmetic was not exhaustively re-verified.
